stem:
Bina has a pile of identical buttons and an ordered drumbeat sequence: first beat, second beat, third beat, and so on. She wants the beat sequence to represent how many buttons are in the pile.

Which claim correctly states what she must do?

options.text: Match each button to exactly one beat in order, with no button left unmatched and no beat left unused for an unmatched button.
Beat once for the whole pile, then name the size from that single sound alone.
Match some buttons to two beats so the sequence runs longer than the pile.
Skip matching the last few buttons once the beats sound familiar.

teacher.key_rationale: Counting needs a one-to-one match between buttons and the ordered beat sequence. A single beat, double-matching, or skipping breaks that mapping.
